## Weekly SERPBear ranking report

Manual or Sunday00:00UTC → configured canonical /api/keywords?domain → latest7available ranked-history mean → one OpenRouter analysis step → one Baserow row. Keep API keys in Header Auth credentials. Source tutorial: https://rumjahn.com/how-to-create-an-a-i-agent-to-analyze-serpbear-keyword-rankings-using-n8n-for-free-without-any-coding-skills-required/

## SERPBear

Configure domain/blog in Prepare Report Scope and the canonical HTTPS host in Read SERPBear Rankings. Header Auth: Authorization: Bearer <your SERPBear API key>. Read timeout30seconds; no redirects. Rank0means outside top100; average excludes zeros and handles missing history. These are latest7observations, not necessarily consecutive days.

## OpenRouter

Select Header Auth Authorization: Bearer <your OpenRouter API key>. The source free route currently has no endpoints; this adaptation uses paid meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct. Check model availability/pricing before activation. Literal JSON message, no added temperature/token budget, no workflow retry.

## Baserow Cloud

Create Date(date), Note(long text), Blog(text). In Save Ranking Report select Database Token credentials with host https://api.baserow.io and your table. Native node reads field metadata then creates the row. Unknown-result failures may already have written a row; no deduplication/retry. See README.
